_comment: Regression test for an oxc_minifier panic, without the Effect pass. oxc_minifier 0.157.0's dead-code elimination (Compressor::run_in_loop) removed one link of a chain of unused const arrow functions per pass, so twelve links kept the loop changing through its 12th pass, where a debug assertion fires: 'Ran loop more than 10 times.' Bundling effect/http/HttpServerResponse hit the same assertion. The vendored oxc_minifier (vendor/oxc_minifier/PATCHED.md) removes such a chain in one pass, and this test passes. treeshake is off so the chain reaches chunk minification. With rolldown's own tree-shaking on, a minifier panic in per-module dead-code elimination runs on a tokio worker and the build hangs instead of failing; errors/plugin_transform_panic covers that hang without the minifier. dead_chain_mixed_order and dead_chain_effectful_inits cover chains the patch does not yet remove within the pass limit.
